: Learn from Qi Tian Emperor, Wu Chi challenges to practice Emei (: Learn from Qi Tian Emperor, Wu Chi challenges to practice Emei (page 22) Seeing the reactions of many yellow scarf thieves, Deputy Marshal Li was shocked and a little at a loss. He is a die-hard fan of Cheng Yuanzhi, how could he surrender? It was just a joke. When he came out of the cave, Tian Boguang's eyes lit up. Even if he saw it from a distance, he could feel that this was definitely a sharp sword in the opponent's hand. Xiahou Yuanxian was indeed old She was so cunning that she wanted Dao Heng to help her get rid of Feng Qingcang and Jing Yuanbai, but she deliberately asked him to see the evidence that Tai Yiyi was really secretly practicing the other two mental techniques. I said, "She said, I love his eyes. , Love his nose, love his walk... He said, I want to wait, I am willing to be exposed to the sun for five hundred years, the wind for five hundred years, and the rain for five hundred years. I just hope that she can walk across the bridge. "When I said this, as a bystander, I couldn't help but shed tears. The leader fell down in unison. The warrior leader looked around and naturally recognized the "Wei Bao" in front of him. He was a close associate of Feng Yufeng, the leader of the "Tiger Group". Last night, not only Grandpa Han came, but also the village chief. Through the crack in the door, she saw the excited expressions of the village chief and Grandpa Han before they left, and also saw the way her father and mother were distracted. She had already guessed that the person living in her house was an adult because of their uncharacteristic behavior this morning. Chen Kaiyang felt a little relieved when he saw Jiayu's transformation. At least Jiayu was trying to change herself to suit him. Liu Huaiyong said, "It's hard work, Brother Tian." After that, everyone went back to rest. Wu Jin pulled Mu Xue into the carriage and walked out of the city. After a while, he saw a farmer's family. Wu Jin walked up and gave the carriage to the family, and the farmer knelt on the ground to thank them.
